verdict.rationale: Cloudflare Registrar documents its own Registrar API for searching, checking, registering, and managing domains, and Cloudflare publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, so programmatic headless use is possible. Nothing in the evidence shows a CLI, CI integration guidance, or headless auth patterns for the registrar specifically, so only the API core of the story is covered. missing for 10: documented CLI or CI/CD workflow, scoped non-interactive auth guidance for registrar operations, hands-on corroboration of automated registrar use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Registrar API for searching, checking, registering, and managing domains through Cloudflare Registrar.
